Map Marker List
Version 1.0.0

A panel down the left of the world map that lists the map's markers top to bottom by name, each with its icon beside it, and
lets you search them by name. Choosing one centres the map on it.

USING IT
Open the world map and press D-pad left on a controller, or / on the keyboard. Outside the world map both presses are left to
the game.

Controller: D-pad up and down or the left stick moves. A centres the map on the highlighted marker and closes the panel. X opens
the on-screen keyboard, Y deletes a letter, B closes the keyboard and then the panel. On the on-screen keyboard the D-pad walks the
letters and A adds one; the first key, shown as _, is the space.

Keyboard and mouse: type to search. Arrows or the wheel move. Enter or a click centres the map. Backspace deletes. Esc or Tab closes.

WHAT IT LISTS
What the map shows. A marker you have not found is not on the map, so it is not here, and a marker type another mod has hidden
(Legendary Map) is left out. A marker the map shows as undiscovered is listed with that same icon.
The icons are drawn by your own map, so icon replacers and CoMAP's icons appear as they do on the map.

SETTINGS
SKSE\Plugins\MapMarkerList.ini: the two keys, the panel's width and its text size.

REQUIREMENTS
SKSE, Address Library, the Apocrypha Menu Framework, and SkyUI's map (or a UI mod built on it, such as Norden UI).
Skyrim 1.5.97, 1.6 or 1.7: the installer picks the build.

Log: Documents\My Games\Skyrim Special Edition\SKSE\MapMarkerList.log
The DLL links CommonLibSSE-NG and is distributed under GPL-3.0-or-later; licence texts are in SKSE\Plugins\MapMarkerList\
